title: Willie Connich band and members
summary: About two years in a Louisiana band led by Willie Connich, with Charlie Toad, his wife on piano and a trumpeter named Ulyss.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in that band? Huh?

Do you remember who he was in that band? Yeah. There's one boy. I know his first name, but I can't, I don't know, I forgot his name. Willie Connich, myself, Charlie Toad, Miss Toad, his wife, and his brother.
His brother played band there? Correct, yeah.

And Charlie played, uh, bass ball. And the wife? And his wife played piano. That's right. And this boy, Ulyss, forget his last name. I know he's doing the name. What instrument was that? Trumpet. Ulyss, yeah. What's the trumpet play?
Oh, he used to play with Joey Lewis at one time. Joey Lewis? Yeah, I think about 45. I don't know. Somebody. Is he from downtown? A real bright guy?
He's from down here. He's from down here.
He lived in Baton Rouge, I think. I don't know. I haven't seen him. He's got a brother named Nelson? Is that the one?

No, no. No. I haven't seen that boy in years. He got out to Middick World for some reason. He got out to Middick World. And, uh, I played with that band quite a while. So, after I left that band, I go to the Supreme Band. And then, that's Eddie Jackson, Peter Lacasse, Phil, Colbeck, Nick Nairn. Uh, we weren't even in the piano that much. I think old man Humphrey, not William Humphrey, his daddy.
